query: find frames where the shape is the most uncertain

definitions.gap_to_overall_uncertainty: shape level minus overall level (percentile points, highest first)
definitions.shape_level: percentile of the body's sigma from body shape alone in the reference (0-100)
definitions.overall_level: percentile of the body's overall sigma (shape and pose) in the reference (0-100)
definitions.body_sigma: root of the mean over the 14 body groups other than c_neck, c_head, c_jaw, l_hand, r_hand of each group's mean squared sigma (cm); head and hands have shape parameters of their own
definitions.body_shape: CLUE's variance of MHR's 20 body-shape parameters alone (identity 0-19), propagated to the vertices
definitions.reference: CLUE's sigma of the body [cm] from body shape alone (MHR identity parameters 0-19) and overall, at 401 quantile levels; per person, the root of the mean over the 14 body groups other than c_neck, c_head, c_jaw, l_hand, r_hand of each group's mean squared sigma; reference population = 7273 person-frames of a curated in-the-wild video
